rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for Monday.

example.english: I have to work on Monday.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sing1 kei4 jat1 jiu3 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this colloquial alternative, especially in speech, instead of 星期一.

example.english: I’m only free to have dinner with you on Monday.
example.traditional: 禮拜一先得閒同你食飯。
example.jyutping: lai5 baai3 jat1 sin1 dak1 haan4 tung4 nei5 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this concise form mainly in schedules and other written contexts.

example.english: Orders close on Monday, so please place yours early.
example.jyutping: zau1 jat1 zit6 daan1 cing2 tai4 cin4 lok6 daan1
